usage: 老撾 (lou5 wo1) is a proper noun used to refer to the country Laos in Cantonese.
It often appears as a subject or object in sentences talking about geography, travel or culture.
老撾 can be combined with verbs like 去 (heoi3 - to go) or 來 (loi4 - to come) to describe movement to or from the country.
In conversations, 老撾 is mostly used in noun phrases and does not change form for tense or number.
You can also use 老撾 in names of things related to the country, like 老撾菜 (Lou5 wo1 coi3 - Laotian food).
